summary: Today's health-tech news reflects ongoing momentum in oncology innovation, AI implementation, and care delivery expansion. Moderna and Merck presented significant developments at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid, though details remain limited pending full publication. On the digital health front, Google outlined its vision for "AI with purpose" in healthcare, while Epic introduced a new Prescription Marketplace price transparency tool and UCHealth shared insights on managing AI deployments and measuring their return on investment. In rehabilitation and social determinants of health, Carda Health partnered with the American College of Lifestyle Medicine to expand virtual rehab capabilities, and Rosarium Health formed a collaboration with Anthem Medi-Cal to provide home safety modifications for eligible members. Opinion pieces highlighted ongoing challenges in diagnostic accuracy for conditions like multiple sclerosis and reflected on lessons from the Theranos controversy regarding testing economics and business models.
